description: You will serve as a FINANCIAL MANAGEMENT ANALYST in the DEPARTMENT OF NAVY, MCICOM of MARCORPS NATIONAL CAPITAL REGION.
educationRequirements: This job does not have an education qualification requirement.
qualifications:
Your resume must demonstrate at least one year of specialized experience at or equivalent to the GS-12 grade level or pay band in the Federal service or equivalent experience in the private or public sector. Specialized experience must demonstrate the following: Performing and overseeing the use accounting/financial systems to perform budget execution, financial analysis, and reporting to stakeholders.

Additional qualification information can be found from the following Office of Personnel Management web site: 0501 Series

Experience refers to paid and unpaid experience, including volunteer work done through National Service programs (e.g., professional, philanthropic, religious, spiritual, community, student, social). Volunteer work helps build critical competencies, knowledge, and skills and can provide valuable training and experience that translates directly to paid employment.
title: FINANCIAL MANAGEMENT ANALYST
